description: Ministry of Local Government - Notification published under Section 3 of Local Authorities (Standard by-Law) Act, No. 06 of 1952 which has to be read with Section 2 of Provincial Council (incidental provisions) Act, No. 12 of 1989
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the approval and publication of amended by-laws for Pradeshiya Sabhas (local authorities) in the Western Province. It references specific legislative acts (Local Authorities Act, Provincial Council Act) and contains a schedule listing various regulatory amendments (e.g., decorations, fish selling, hotels, meat selling, etc.). This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it deals with subsidiary legislation and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
